03

Latest name check

A federal geographic resource identifies the Yocona River watershed in northern Mississippi. That finding alone does not identify an Indigenous people, historical town or intended spelling behind the supplied directory name. The entry remains available while name verification continues; no tribal map location has been assigned from the river name.

Read the sources [2] USDA Natural Resources Conservation Service

What needs further research

  • Identify the original source and intended referent of the supplied name. River-name etymology or nearby Chickasaw history is insufficient to establish a distinct people.
